items.title: AWS Launches Amazon GuardDuty Investigation Agent to Automate Threat Triage
items.summary: AWS released a public preview of the GuardDuty investigation agent, which correlates findings, 90-day activity logs, and resource topologies into structured reports with risk ratings, confidence scores, and MITRE ATT&CK classification. It is reachable through the AWS MCP Server, so investigations can run from agentic tooling. Preview quotas cap usage at 10 investigations per account per day. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Presentation: Clean Architecture for Serverless: Business Logic You Can Take Anywhere
items.summary: Elena van Engelen discusses how to eliminate serverless vendor lock-in without sacrificing native cloud capabilities. She explains how to structure FaaS applications using Clean Architecture, Spring Cloud Function, and Gradle modules to isolate business logic. Finally, she shares a live demo deploying portable Kotlin services across AWS and Azure using Terraform CDK for multi-cloud IaC. By Elena van Engelen

items.title: Article: An Evolutionary Architecture Pattern for Managing AI’s Pace of Change
items.summary: Traditional API gateways assume deterministic services and simple schemas - assumptions agentic AI breaks. Discover why enterprise engineering leaders are adopting AI Gateways as an evolutionary architecture seam. Centralize guardrails, model routing, agent identity, action policy, and semantic audit within a single control plane to prevent costly incidents while keeping core platforms stable. By Joe Price, Branimir Đurek, Pavlos Migkiros, Trevor Dearham

items.title: software-architektur.tv: James Coplien stellt das Dependency-Denken infrage
items.summary: In der englischsprachigen Episode diskutiert Eberhard Wolff mit James Coplien, ob Softwarearchitektur wirklich vor allem das Management von Abhängigkeiten ist?

topics.summary: Aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Cloud-Architektur und Plattformen zeigen Fortschritte in der Automatisierung von Bedrohungsanalysen, der Handhabung von Serverless-Anwendungen und der Integration von KI in Architekturansätze. Experten diskutieren zudem die Herausforderungen und Konzepte der Softwarearchitektur.
highlights: AWS hat den GuardDuty Investigation Agent in der öffentlichen Vorschau veröffentlicht, der Bedrohungen automatisiert analysiert und strukturiert.
Elena van Engelen demonstriert, wie man mit Clean Architecture und Terraform CDK serverlose Anwendungen plattformübergreifend bereitstellt.
Neue Architekturansätze, wie AI Gateways, werden von Unternehmen angenommen, um die Herausforderungen durch agentische KI zu bewältigen.

items.title: Microsoft Releases .NET 11 Preview 6 With Language and Framework Updates
items.summary: Microsoft has released .NET 11 Preview 6, with updates across C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, and Entity Framework Core. C# adds extension indexers and built-in union support types. ASP.NET Core brings async validation, automatic CSRF protection, and OpenAPI 3.2 by default. MAUI extends CollectionView to Windows, and EF Core adds FULL OUTER JOIN translation. By Almir Vuk

items.title: Java News Roundup: Simple JSON API, JEPs for JDK 28, Oracle CPUs, Embabel 1.0, Azul Payara, Helidon
items.summary: This week's Java roundup for July 20th, 2026, features news highlighting: two JEPs proposed to target for JDK 28; new JEPs 540 and 541, Simple JSON API (Incubator) and Deprecate the macOS/x64 Port for Removal, respectively; the July 2026 Critical Patch Update; the GA release of Embable 1.0; Azul Payara 7.2.0; and Helidon 4.5.1. By Michael Redlich

items.title: TanStack Table V9 Beta: Tree-Shakable Features, TanStack Store State, and Lower Memory Usage
items.summary: TanStack Table V9 is a beta release of a headless UI library for creating tables in various JavaScript frameworks. It features improved state management, memory usage, and extensibility. The notable change is an opt-in feature model, allowing developers to load only necessary components. Migration is gradual, with tools provided for legacy support. The library remains free and developer-focused. By Daniel Curtis

topics.summary: Die Software-Architektur entwickelt sich weiter mit neuen Updates in .NET und Java. Microsoft hat .NET 11 Preview 6 veröffentlicht, während die Java-Community neue JEPs für JDK 28 und weitere Tools vorstellt.
highlights: .NET 11 Preview 6 bringt Updates für C#, ASP.NET Core und Entity Framework Core.
